Careers

Join Our Team at Mercy Cares Counseling Services, LLC

Are you a dedicated and compassionate mental health professional looking to make a meaningful impact? Mercy Cares Counseling Services, LLC is expanding and we're seeking talented Licensed Graduate Professional Counselors (LGPCs) and Licensed Therapists to join our growing team.

About Us

At Mercy Cares Counseling Services, LLC, we are committed to helping individuals heal from past traumas, current struggles, and look to a positive future. Our approach is deeply rooted in fostering a positive therapeutic alliance and providing a safe, non-judgmental space for clients. We specialize in mood disorders, anxiety, depression, ADHD, spiritual issues, men's issues, and couples counseling

Current Openings

  • Licensed Graduate Professional Counselors (LGPCs)
  • Licensed Therapists

Qualifications

  • For LGPCs: A Master’s degree in Counseling or a related field and current LGPC licensure.
  • For Licensed Therapists: A Master’s degree in Counseling, Social Work, or a related field and current licensure as a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), or equivalent.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth

How To Apply

If you are passionate about helping clients heal, cope, and thrive, and want to be part of a supportive and dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a cover letter detailing your experience and why you are interested in joining us to mercycares3@outlook.com or call the office @ 443-741-2457.
